name: io.github.merit-ecru/merit
description: Proof-of-citation verification for AI agents. Verify a (claim, source) before paying for it — a signed, tamper-evident SUPPORTED/REFUSED verdict a settlement hook can consume so a hallucinated citation never settles — or run a full research agent that pays sources only for citations that verify, in sub-cent USDC on Circle's Arc.

environmentVariables.name: MERIT_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a running Merit server (default http://localhost:3000; the hosted instance is https://onmerit.xyz).

tools.name: verify_citation
tools.description: Verify whether a citation is GROUNDED before paying for it. Give a (claim, source) pair; get back a SIGNED, tamper-evident verdict (SUPPORTED/REFUSED) from a deterministic numeric verifier + NLI + an adversarial LLM judge. Read-only, idempotent, spends no USDC, publishes nothing. Gate ANY agent's citation payments with it — including self-report agents whose 'citation' is one LLM grading its own homework.

tools.name: merit_research
tools.description: Ask Merit a question with a USDC budget: it hires specialist sub-agents, writes a cited answer, verifies each citation with an adversarial proof-of-citation judge, pays only the sources actually used (sub-cent USDC on Arc) and refuses the rest, and records on-chain ERC-8004 reputation. Returns the answer plus a receipt. SPENDS real USDC and is NOT idempotent.
